Before you apply

Who can apply for US LIVE?

Adults based in the US can discuss eligibility with us. Tell us if you already belong to another network. We confirm current TikTok criteria and any streaming expectations before onboarding.

Does Sparked take a cut of my LIVE gifts?

Sparked’s network cut is zero. This is separate from TikTok’s platform rules and payout calculations. It is not an earnings guarantee or a statement about Shop commission terms.

Does registering interest sign me up?

No. A WhatsApp conversation does not enroll you. US LIVE network invitations are accepted inside TikTok. Any work or commercial arrangement needs its own agreed terms.

Can I leave a network?

Ask us about the current release process and any applicable agreement before joining. TikTok’s current rules and your agreement govern the process.
